title: Payload replay reaches halt
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and choose a host configuration, an input-head position, flag and counter tapes, an integer counter-head position, and a Boolean word $w$. Form a host configuration in control phase $13$ whose payload tape stores $w$ from cell zero, whose payload head is at zero, whose output is empty, and whose other components are those specified by the chosen host configuration, position, flag, and counter data. After $|w|+1$ steps of the loop host, the resulting configuration is halted and its output is exactly $w$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
